name: personal-purchasing-power-chat
description: Chat-web household basket, purchasing-power loss, investment counterfactuals, and dollar or euro cash when relevant. Not investment advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat about a household basket and purchasing power.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country where the household buys the basket.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.description: ISO 4217 code of the basket's unit of account.

inputs.name: period-start
inputs.description: Start date of the cited window.

inputs.name: period-end
inputs.description: End date of the cited window.

inputs.name: basket
inputs.description: Items, spend shares, and any prices the user states.

inputs.name: stake
inputs.description: Lump sum for the counterfactuals. Optional.

inputs.name: future-years
inputs.description: Horizon in years for labeled scenarios. Optional.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: personal-purchasing-power-report
outputs.description: Household report; empty until minimum inputs exist.
